concept_summary: The fantasy of Lightkeeper: steer ships with one lighthouse beam replanted on one shared map where every player acts at once and every move is visible. Resources, storms, and scarcities hit everyone simultaneously, so private optimization loses to public negotiation. The game only functions above fifty concurrent players.
first_experiment: Moderated crowd test: put fifteen volunteers on one shared board for twenty minutes; if alliances form without prompting, the social layer carries the game.
source_idea_title: Lightkeeper: steer ships with one lighthouse beam
why_it_is_opposite: While the source is a private experience, this concept flips it into a crowd: playing alone is impossible here, whereas the source never requires another person.

concept_summary: A reverse-loop game in the world of Theodolite: map a county by triangulation: you begin holding everything the source hands out and win by giving it all back. Where the source loop is 'Take bearings from known stations and triangulate the positions of unseen landmarks; each measurement is a finite resource and the map fills in one fix at a time.', here every move undoes the 'Take bearings from known stations and triangulate the positions of unseen landmarks; each measurement is a finite resource and the map fills in one fix at a time.' loop step by step instead of advancing it, so the map empties and the score falls. Hoarding triggers the lose state; the end screen celebrates an empty board.
first_experiment: Paper prototype: ten tokens stand in for everything the player owns and each turn must discard at least one; test with five players whether emptying the board feels like winning after three rounds.
source_idea_title: Theodolite: map a county by triangulation
why_it_is_opposite: While the source rewards accumulation (Take bearings from known stations and triangulate the positions of unseen landmarks; each measurement is a finite resource and the map fills in one fix at a time.), this concept rewards the opposite: progress means having less, so a winning run here would score zero in the source.

concept_summary: The fantasy of Stop Walking: one button, four air jumps, ten catches stretched over a single persistent season lasting months: one meaningful decision per evening, no grinding, no catching up. Progress compounds across real calendar time and a missed week bends the story instead of ending it. The finale is scheduled, shared, and unrepeatable.
first_experiment: Concierge test: run the core decision by hand over seven daily messages with three players; if day-seven return beats the source's second-session return, the long form has legs.
source_idea_title: Stop Walking: one button, four air jumps, ten catches
why_it_is_opposite: While the source fits short, this concept flips the clock: one season here outlasts hundreds of source sessions, so the source habit of quick payoff actively hurts.
